-- Behavioral test double, not a Roblox renderer. Tweens complete only when requested.
local allSignals, allTweens, deferred, delayed = {}, {}, {}, {}
function signal()
  local event = { listeners = {} }
  allSignals[#allSignals + 1] = event
  function event:Connect(callback)
    local connection = { Connected = true }
    self.listeners[connection] = callback
    function connection:Disconnect() self.Connected = false; event.listeners[self] = nil end
    return connection
  end
  function event:Fire(...)
    local copy = table.clone(self.listeners)
    for connection, callback in pairs(copy) do
      if connection.Connected then callback(...) end
    end
  end
  function event:Wait() return coroutine.yield() end
  return event
end
function listenerCount()
  local count = 0
  for _, event in ipairs(allSignals) do for _ in pairs(event.listeners) do count = count + 1 end end
  return count
end
function activeTweenCount()
  local count = 0
  for _, tween in ipairs(allTweens) do if tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then count = count + 1 end end
  return count
end
function finishTweens()
  for pass = 1, 20 do
    local copy, pending = table.clone(allTweens), 0
    for _, tween in ipairs(copy) do
      if tween.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then tween:Finish(); pending = pending + 1 end
    end
    if pending == 0 then return end
  end
  error('Tween completion did not settle')
end
function flushDeferred()
  local copy = deferred
  deferred = {}
  for _, callback in ipairs(copy) do callback() end
end
function flushDelays()
  local copy = delayed
  delayed = {}
  for _, callback in ipairs(copy) do callback() end
end
Enum = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(self, group)
  local result = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(values, name)
    local value = { Name = name, __type = 'EnumItem', EnumType = values }
    rawset(values, name, value)
    return value
  end })
  rawset(self, group, result)
  return result
end })
UDim = { new = function(scale, offset) return {Scale = scale or 0, Offset = offset or 0} end }
UDim2 = { new = function(xs, xo, ys, yo) return { X = UDim.new(xs, xo), Y = UDim.new(ys, yo) } end }
UDim2.fromOffset = function(x,y) return UDim2.new(0,x,0,y) end
UDim2.fromScale = function(x,y) return UDim2.new(x,0,y,0) end
Vector2 = { new = function(x,y) return {X=x or 0, Y=y or 0,__type='Vector2'} end }
Vector2.zero = Vector2.new(0,0)
Color3 = { fromRGB = function(r,g,b) return {R=r/255,G=g/255,B=b/255} end, new = function(r,g,b) return {R=r,G=g,B=b} end }
ColorSequence = { new = function(x) return x end }
ColorSequenceKeypoint = { new = function(t,c) return {t,c} end }
NumberSequence = { new = function(x) return x end }
TweenInfo = { new = function(duration,style,direction) return {duration=duration,style=style,direction=direction} end }
function typeof(value) return type(value)=='table' and value.__type or type(value) end
function warn(...) end
local methods = {}
local guiClasses = {Frame=true,CanvasGroup=true,TextButton=true,TextLabel=true,TextBox=true,ScrollingFrame=true}
local inputEvents = {Activated=true,MouseEnter=true,MouseLeave=true,InputBegan=true,InputChanged=true,InputEnded=true,Destroying=true,Focused=true,FocusLost=true,Idled=true}
function methods:IsA(class)
  if self.ClassName == class then return true end
  if class == 'GuiObject' then return guiClasses[self.ClassName] == true end
  if class == 'GuiButton' then return self.ClassName == 'TextButton' end
  return false
end
function methods:GetChildren() return table.clone(self._children) end
function methods:GetDescendants()
  local result = {}
  local function visit(object)
    for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do result[#result+1]=child; visit(child) end
  end
  visit(self)
  return result
end
function methods:FindFirstChild(name)
  for _, child in ipairs(self._children) do if child.Name == name then return child end end
end
function methods:WaitForChild(name) return assert(self:FindFirstChild(name),name) end
function methods:FindFirstChildOfClass(class)
  for _, child in ipairs(self._children) do if child:IsA(class) then return child end end
end
function methods:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property)
  if not self._events[property] then self._events[property]=signal() end
  return self._events[property]
end
function methods:SetAttribute(key,value) self._attributes[key]=value end
function methods:GetAttribute(key) return self._attributes[key] end
function methods:Destroy()
  if self._destroyed then return end
  self._destroyed=true
  self.Destroying:Fire()
  for _, child in ipairs(self:GetChildren()) do child:Destroy() end
  self.Parent=nil
  for _, event in pairs(self._events) do
    for connection in pairs(table.clone(event.listeners)) do connection:Disconnect() end
  end
end
local instanceMeta = {
  __index = function(self,key)
    if methods[key] then return methods[key] end
    if self._props[key] ~= nil then return self._props[key] end
    if inputEvents[key] then
      if not self._events[key] then self._events[key] = signal() end
      return self._events[key]
    end
    return self:FindFirstChild(key)
  end,
  __newindex = function(self,key,value)
    if key:sub(1,1)=='_' then rawset(self,key,value); return end
    local previous = self._props[key]
    if key=='Parent' and previous ~= value then
      if previous then
        for i, child in ipairs(previous._children) do if child==self then table.remove(previous._children,i); break end end
      end
      if value then value._children[#value._children+1]=self end
    end
    self._props[key]=value
    if previous~=value and self._events[key] then self._events[key]:Fire() end
  end,
}
Instance = { new = function(class)
  local object = setmetatable({
    _children={},_events={},_attributes={},
    _props={ClassName=class,Name=class,Visible=true,Active=true,Selectable=true,Position=UDim2.new(),Size=UDim2.new(),
      AnchorPoint=Vector2.zero,AbsolutePosition=Vector2.new(100,100),AbsoluteSize=Vector2.new(200,28),
      AbsoluteContentSize=Vector2.new(200,80),CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero,BackgroundTransparency=0,
      TextTransparency=0,TextStrokeTransparency=1,Text='',GroupTransparency=0,ZIndex=1,Scale=1,Rotation=0,
    },
  }, instanceMeta)
  if class=='BindableEvent' then object.Event=signal(); object.Fire=function(self) self.Event:Fire() end end
  return object
end }
local UIS = Instance.new('UserInputService')
UIS.InputBegan=signal();UIS.InputChanged=signal();UIS.InputEnded=signal();UIS.WindowFocusReleased=signal()
UIS.KeyboardEnabled=true;UIS.MouseEnabled=true;UIS.TouchEnabled=false
function UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() return self.focused end
local heartbeat=signal()
local tweenService={}
function tweenService:Create(object,profile,goals)
  local tween={Completed=signal(),PlaybackState=Enum.PlaybackState.Begin,object=object,profile=profile,goals=goals}
  allTweens[#allTweens+1]=tween
  function tween:Play() self.PlaybackState=Enum.PlaybackState.Playing end
  function tween:Cancel()
    if self.PlaybackState==Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then self.PlaybackState=Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled;self.Completed:Fire(self.PlaybackState) end
  end
  function tween:Finish()
    for key,value in pairs(self.goals) do self.object[key]=value end
    self.PlaybackState=Enum.PlaybackState.Completed;self.Completed:Fire(self.PlaybackState)
  end
  return tween
end
local player=Instance.new('Player')
local playerGui=Instance.new('PlayerGui'); playerGui.Parent=player
player.UserId=1
local services={
  UserInputService=UIS,TweenService=tweenService,RunService={Heartbeat=heartbeat},Players={LocalPlayer=player},
  TextService={GetTextSize=function(_,value) return Vector2.new(#value*7,18) end},
}
game={GetService=function(_,name) return assert(services[name],name) end}
workspace={CurrentCamera=Instance.new('Camera')}
workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize=Vector2.new(1280,720)
task={
  spawn=function(callback) local co=coroutine.create(callback);local ok,err=coroutine.resume(co);assert(ok,err);return co end,
  defer=function(callback) deferred[#deferred+1]=callback end,
  delay=function(_,callback) delayed[#delayed+1]=callback end,
  wait=function() return coroutine.yield() end,
}
function findDescendant(root,name)
  for _, object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if object.Name==name then return object end end
  error('Missing descendant '..name)
end
function click(root) root.Activated:Fire() end
function input(kind,x,y,key) return {UserInputType=Enum.UserInputType[kind],Position=Vector2.new(x,y),KeyCode=Enum.KeyCode[key or 'Unknown']} end
